d:
The hunt for Bigfoot begins deep in the forests of Oregon! Armed with advanced technology, an expert team sets out to track the elusive creature. From strange sounds and mysterious footprints to possible nests and unexplained thermal images, every discovery brings them closer to understanding what could be hiding in the wilderness. But will their first expedition lead them to Bigfoot?
Watch Expedition Bigfoot, S1, Episodes 1, 7, 6, 2, 4, 5 & 8 on Discovery Channel India.
